title: Compare values carefully
summary: Equality checks need to match the data you care about. Two different objects are not the same object even if their fields match.
introduction: Equality checks need to match the data you care about. Two different objects are not the same object even if their fields match. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.text: Use a test runner's deep-value matcher when checking object contents.
